name: Precision Practice Management
short_description: Precision Practice Management offers full-service outsourced billing and RCM for psychiatry and behavioral health practices.
long_description: Precision Practice Management is a full-service revenue cycle management company specializing in psychiatry and behavioral health practices. The company provides comprehensive outsourced billing services including claims submission, payment posting, denial management, and provider credentialing. Precision Practice Management uses a percentage-of-collections pricing model (typically 5-9%) and works with practices of all sizes seeking to outsource their billing operations to behavioral health billing experts.
one_liner: Full-service outsourced billing and RCM for psychiatry practices.
best_for: Psychiatry and behavioral health practices seeking outsourced billing
Practices wanting full revenue cycle management services
Organizations needing credentialing and enrollment support
